newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Thursday January 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Thursday January 2.

text.p: Following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.
*President Oscar Luigi Scalfaro appeals for more dialogue and less mudslinging in politics and says business and politics should be kept separate in his end of year speech.
*Italian total 1996 budget deficit likely to reach 137 trillion lire, according to provisional figures, against 130 trillion in 1995. (Il Sole)
*Troubled information technology group Olivetti's net financial debt falls to 2.92 trillion lire at the end of November from 3.03 trillion in the previous month.(Il Sole, Repubblica)
*Yellow pages publisher Seat to start trading on the stock market from today. (Il Sole)
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
